implementation_strategy: Use the hosted_netops_gvr_v1 executor calling openai_responses gpt-5-mini. For each seed (1..300) issue one shared initial generation call (used for both baseline and guarded conditions). Run deterministic canonicalization → AST parse → frozen deterministic validator. For guarded-arm invalid outputs invoke at most one automated repair generation call per task, apply canonicalization + validator again, and record repair trace. All scoring and pass/fail decisions are automated using the registered deterministic validator and scorer.
task_manifest_strategy: Deterministic generation from the frozen seed list (task IDs 0001–0300). Seeds that produce uninterpretable intents are deterministically replaced from the preregistered reserve list; every inclusion/exclusion/replacement is logged.
transformation_manifest_strategy: Apply whitespace/token canonicalization, vendor-template parameter mapping, and AST-based syntax normalization (frozen transformation unit tests). Reject outputs that fail AST parse; such seeds are excluded/replaced deterministically.
randomisation_plan: No randomisation. Paired within-task design with deterministic seed list; conditions share the same initial candidate per task (shared_initial_candidate).
caching_plan: Cache every model response, canonicalized configuration, AST, validator output, and repair trace in an immutable artifact store keyed by task_id and condition. One-time caching of transformation unit-test artifacts is used locally; no retrieval/RAG is performed.
failure_recovery_plan: No human labour. For any model/API technical failure record failure type and timestamp. Maximum attempts per call = 1 (no programmatic retries). Primary analysis uses 'complete_pair_primary' (drop pairs only if both condition calls failed). Sensitivity analysis treats any failed generation as failure. All failures are logged in the execution manifest.
result_schema: Per-episode JSON record: {task_id, condition, model_call_id, model_prompt, model_response, canonical_config, config_ast, validator_result {pass:boolean, failure_categories:[]}, repair_call_trace (if any), final_status, hashes, timestamps}. Aggregated paired pass/fail table produced for analysis.
estimated_compute_notes: Total model calls worst-case = 300 initial shared generations + up to 300 guarded reparations = 600 calls to hosted gpt-5-mini. Hosted API calls and deterministic local canonicalization/validation fit within the capability manifest budget (≤10000 calls) and wall-clock (expected <7 days). Storage for artifacts per-call estimated ~50KB → ~30 MB total; all artifacts logged and hashed.
